answer: The candle shed smells of tallow, the dipping frame hung with rods. Proof of candlemaker via tallow candle tally — a candle the candlemaker dips only after 43 candles hold their wick without one guttering in the draught, each dipped by the candlemaker herself. shale melts the tallow in the vat and skims it clean. ledge hangs the wicks on the frame and dips them slow. haven lifts the candles out to cool and trims each wick. Forty-three candles must hold their wick without one guttering in the draught, and the next still gutters where the tallow ran thin.
